title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-04-15
lineage: SBD > Bear's MC > ? > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Decent soundboard snippet with okay audio, offering a brief but pleasant glimpse of a solid 1969 performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is a short excerpt that captures a fairly good show; the sound quality is described as merely "ok," making it suitable as filler material alongside the full concert from the same venue. While the music feels semi‑sweet, the limited length and modest audio fidelity keep it from being a standout release.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review; reviewer finds the music decent but notes only okay sound quality, resulting in an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound described as "ok" – acceptable clarity for a short segment but not exceptional; no major issues reported.
